response.answer: The sources indicate that the ticket price for Jerónimos Monastery will increase from €12 to €18 starting from the new year. This information is provided by an Instagram post from ivanainportugal. The Jerónimos Monastery Cloister Tickets & Highlights page and the Get Your Guide listing do not specify future ticket prices but list current and other related attractions' prices starting from €15. There is no information about ticket prices beyond the stated increase.

ivanainportugal

Starting from the new year, entrance fees for several museums and monuments will change:  
 • Jerónimos Monastery: The fee will increase from €12 to €18.  
 • Belém Tower: The fee will rise significantly from €8 to €15.  
  
I bought my tickets on @getyourguide—it’s definitely the easiest way!  
  
Maybe these price increases will help reduce the long queues. What do you think—would you like to visit?
